title: R6B district - no side yard is required for a residence other than a single- or two-family detached one (ZR 23-335(b)); a commercial overlay removes the requirement for any residential building (ZR 34-232)
description: DRAFT extraction (needs_review) of the side-yard rule for R6B. ZR 23-335(b): for all residences other than single- or two-family detached ones, no side yard is required (any open area along a side lot line must be at least five feet wide). Under a commercial overlay ZR 34-232 removes the side-yard requirement for any residential building. A single- or two-family detached residence requires two 5-foot side yards under ZR 23-335(a) without the overlay. The building-type table and the open-area minimum are read as a labelled draft in envelope_constraints.py; this rule records the 'no side yard required' result for the all-other-buildings case.

citations.quote: In the districts indicated, for zoning lots containing all other types of residences, no side yards shall be required. However, if any open area extending along a side lot line is provided at any level, it shall have a minimum width of five feet, measured perpendicular to the side lot line.

In the districts indicated, no side yard shall be required for any residential building. However, if any open area extending along a side lot line is provided at any level, it shall have a minimum width of five feet, measured perpendicular to the side lot line.
All regulations applicable to a district designation shall be applicable to such district designation appended with a suffix, except as otherwise set forth in express provisions of this Resolution.

inputs.name: zoning_district
inputs.description: Residence district governing the lot (scope enforced by applicability in_set R6B).

inputs.name: overlay_present
inputs.description: True iff a commercial overlay is mapped on the lot (profile zoning.commercial_overlays[] non-empty).

inputs.name: special_district_present
inputs.description: True iff a special purpose district is mapped; when true the result escalates to professional review.

inputs.name: single_or_two_family_detached
inputs.description: True iff the building is a single- or two-family detached residence (ZR 23-335(a) then requires two 5-foot side yards without the overlay). A design fact supplied by the caller; not supplied -> no side-yard result.

outputs.name: side_yard_required
outputs.description: 0 = no side yard is required for an all-other-buildings residence (ZR 23-335(b); ZR 34-232 under a commercial overlay). The detached case and the 5-foot open-area minimum are read in envelope_constraints.py.

parameters.name: side_yard_required_all_other_buildings
parameters.note: ZR 23-335(b): no side yard required for all residences other than single- or two-family detached ones.

steps.note: ZR 23-335(b): no side yard is required.

exceptions.description: A single- or two-family detached residence requires two side yards, each at least five feet wide (ZR 23-335(a)), unless a commercial overlay removes it (ZR 34-232); read in envelope_constraints.py.
Any open area provided along a side lot line must be at least five feet wide (ZR 23-335(b) / 34-232).
ZR 23 and 35 list R6 through R12 and do not name R6B; the rule reaches R6B through ZR 11-25 (suffix inheritance), flagged for the reviewer.
A special purpose district is mapped on this lot and may modify residence-district bulk; its provisions are not captured here, so the result is not emitted as final. Professional review required.

limitations: Draft extraction pending independent review and G6 qualified-human legal approval; not a Verified determination.
The detached-residence case (two 5-foot side yards under ZR 23-335(a)) and the 5-foot open-area minimum are read in envelope_constraints.py, not this rule.
This rule never measures geometry; the site facts are supplied by the caller.
